purpose: Public-safe release evidence ledger rendered on /intelligence. Records what was OBSERVED, when, and by which kind of check. No hostnames, service identifiers, account names or credentials. Unknown is never healthy; an observation older than freshnessDays is shown as stale and treated as unknown.

candidate.label: Draft PR #29 (combined runtime-qualification candidate)
candidate.ciEvidence: 18/18 check runs successful at 33be89a (incl. mysql-integration on MySQL 8.0, mysql-84-compatibility on MySQL 8.4, e2e, release-artifact and release-evidence with the artifactIdentity gate), read 25 Oct 2026; 89239c5 had 19/19 including the path-filtered preflight
candidate.note: Commits pushed after the CI-verified commit are source-implemented only until their own CI run is read. The exact head is whatever this page's build reports below.

deployment.method: Hosting provider API, read-only, 25 Oct 2026: one web service, auto-deploy off, latest live deploy 469c668 (10 Oct), not suspended, start command still pnpm start
deployment.note: The preview serves an older commit than the CI-verified candidate. Deploying the candidate is an owner-approved, gated action.

layers.name: Gateway and Creator security fixes (local-slot classification, redirects, pinned endpoint profiles)
layers.evidence: Reproduced on 0a48dc3, fixed, unit-tested and mutation-checked; CI-verified at 2eb2b6e. Not deployed.

layers.name: Repository CI on the candidate
layers.evidence: 18/18 check runs at 33be89a, including MySQL 8.0 and 8.4 containers, browser e2e and the retained exact-commit release artifact. Later commits need their own CI run.

layers.name: Preview deployment serves the candidate
layers.evidence: Preview serves 469c668; no candidate build is deployed. The preview is still running (suspension approved, not executed).
layers.blocker: Owner approval for a preview redeploy; preview service suspension (decision Q2) is approved but not executed.

layers.name: Preview database inspected and migrated
layers.evidence: No read-only inspection of the preview database exists for the candidate. Pending migrations for the preview are 0011-0013 (all additive). Inspect mode at the candidate ref is source-verified read-only. The default-branch copy of the workflow is an unguarded migrator; a separate fail-closed replacement is prepared on a maintenance branch, not merged.
layers.blocker: Delete the legacy repository secret first; then owner approval for power-on and an inspect dispatch from the candidate ref (never the default branch); then a separately approved migrate run.

layers.name: Live session revocation and tenant isolation
layers.evidence: Covered by source tests; never exercised against a deployed candidate.

layers.name: Malware scanner runtime and file ingestion
layers.evidence: Upload path fails closed without a scanner; no live clean/EICAR/unavailable-scanner acceptance exists.
layers.blocker: Approved scanner runtime and its acceptance evidence. Ingestion stays disabled until then.

layers.name: Real model execution
layers.evidence: No genuine local or hosted model call has been recorded. Tamil quality is not measured.
layers.blocker: Owner-run evaluation (Q8-eval) or a local model run; hosted providers stay disabled by default.

layers.name: Paid Creator generation
layers.evidence: Fail-closed authorization and spend ledger exist in source; paid generation is disabled.
layers.blocker: Runtime verification of server-side budget and authorization controls before any enablement.

layers.name: Request limits shared across instances
layers.evidence: Shared limiter with an explicit failure policy (costly routes refuse, others use a scaled per-process bound), bounded failures and readiness reporting; its table is migration 0013. Tested on real MySQL with independent connection pools. Not deployed; the default stays per-process, which is correct for one instance.

layers.name: Production environment
layers.evidence: No production web service, production database, object storage bucket or domain exists. Only the preview service is defined.
layers.blocker: Owner decision to provision production infrastructure after preview acceptance (spend-bearing).

layers.name: Built-artifact identity
layers.evidence: Each build writes a SHA-256 manifest of dist (server and browser components, source commit, lockfile, toolchain, build-time VITE fingerprint); the server re-verifies it at startup and reports it on /releasez. CI retained release-artifact-33be89a (90 days) and its release-evidence gate reproduced the digest on a second runner. The host rebuilds from source, so a deploy is tied by digest equality, not yet observed on a deployed build.

layers.name: Security-qualified rollback
layers.evidence: Rollback targets must contain the security baseline; the build the preview serves today (469c668) is forbidden as a target and can only be contained by suspension. Builds from this candidate add tested application maintenance mode (SAKTHIAI_MAINTENANCE_MODE=true), a second containment path once such a build serves the environment.
layers.blocker: First live-verified deployment of a candidate at or after the security baseline.
